🚨 NEW: Claude Fable 5 can now run your LinkedIn outbound from a single chat.

Find high-intent leads.

We built a one-click connector that gives Claude access to your LinkedIn outbound workflow.

Claude can identify leads based on signals like hiring, funding, job changes, competitor engagement, and more.

Ask:

“Find prospects who engaged with my competitors this week.”

Give Claude a company.

It finds the right decision-maker, researches the person and company, enriches their contact information, and adds them to your list.

No bouncing between LinkedIn, Apollo, spreadsheets, enrichment tools, and your CRM.

4/ Write personalized outreach

Claude uses each prospect’s actual context, activity, and buying signals to write the message.

Not another generic AI template with {{First Name}} swapped in.

5/ Manage replies + move prospects toward meetings

When someone responds, Claude can help qualify the opportunity, continue the conversation, follow up, and move interested prospects toward a call.

6/ Run outreach across multiple accounts

You can manage several LinkedIn accounts from the same workflow.

7/ Understand what’s actually working

Just ask:

“Which job titles had the highest reply rate this week?”

“Which buying signals generated the most conversations?”

“Who should I follow up with today?”

Claude gives you the answer.

The best part is the interface:

There basically isn’t one.

You just talk to Claude.

No complicated workflows.
